description.value: Sunset Motel is a roadside motel located on McIntyre Drive on Vancouver Island, in the community area around Port Alberni. The OSM record was field-verified in April 2024 and accepts cash, Visa, and Mastercard. No cyclist-specific amenities could be confirmed from available data.
